label: equivalent
rationale: The predicates `at` in both JACK_NP and REMA_NP express the same concept: spatial location. The arguments `?e` and `?l` represent an entity and a location, respectively. The action contexts demonstrate this by using `at` to specify the location of entities within scenes. The predicates share identical declarations and parameter types, confirming their interchangeable relation. The differing action contexts do not alter this fundamental equivalence; they simply provide different details about how the spatial relationship is established and utilized within each narrative.
